description: This file defines the 'CheckPermission' class, which implements a method operation for the 'mini-language' of the project, specifically handling the '<check-permission>' element. It includes logic for checking user permissions, processing alternative permissions, and generating error messages within the framework.

classes.name: CheckPermission
classes.description: Implements the functionality for the '<check-permission>' element in the mini-language, including permission checks, message handling, and error logging.

classes.name: CheckPermission.PermissionInfo
classes.description: A nested class that encapsulates permission information, including permission and action expanders, and methods to evaluate permissions.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the permission check logic within the provided method context. Checks user permissions, evaluates alternative permissions, and records error messages if permission is denied.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the '<check-permission>' element with its attributes.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a CheckPermission object from XML element and simple method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the factory, 'check-permission'.

methods.name: PermissionInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializes permission and action expanders from XML attributes and provides permission checking method.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Evaluates whether the user has the specified permission or entity permission based on the expanders.
